taglineZh: 把干货内容拆成多张 3:4 知识卡，联排可滑动
taglineEn: Turn tips into a swipeable set of 3:4 knowledge cards
descZh: 把一段内容拆成封面、观点卡和总结卡，每张 1080×1440，只讲一个观点。适合发小红书或朋友圈的干货合集，产出柔和莫兰迪配色、大字号的可截图卡片组。
descEn: Splits content into a cover card, one-point-per-card body cards and a summary card at 1080x1440 each. Built for Xiaohongshu tip posts; outputs a screenshot-ready carousel in soft Morandi tones with large type.
outputZh: 多张 3:4 卡片联排 HTML
demoCaptionZh: 一组可横滑的 AI 使用习惯知识卡，含封面与总结页
demoCaptionEn: A swipeable set of AI-habit tip cards with cover and summary

taglineZh: 侧导航 + 正文 + 目录的三栏文档，长读优先
taglineEn: Three-column docs: side nav, article, sticky TOC
descZh: 做单页 API 或教程文档：左侧固定导航、中间正文带代码块和三色提示框、右侧目录随滚动高亮。适合产品说明和开发文档，产出带搜索、版本切换和主题切换的 HTML 页面。
descEn: Builds a single-page API or tutorial doc: sticky side nav, article body with code blocks and tri-color callouts, and a scroll-spy TOC. Ships as one HTML page with search, version picker and theme toggle.
demoCaptionZh: 灵犀 API 快速开始文档，含代码复制、提示框与目录高亮
demoCaptionEn: Lingxi API quickstart docs with copy buttons, callouts and TOC spy

taglineZh: 可搜索、可分类筛选的手风琴常见问题页
descZh: 把 12-18 条真实问答按类别组织，顶部搜索实时过滤，分类胶囊切换，答案点击展开。适合帮助中心和客服支持页，产出语义化 details 手风琴的单页 HTML，键盘可用。
descEn: Organizes 12-18 real Q&As by category with live search filtering, category pills and click-to-expand answers. For help centers and support pages; outputs one HTML file with semantic details accordions and keyboard support.
outputZh: 可搜索手风琴 FAQ 单页
demoCaptionZh: 云雀协作帮助中心，搜索与分类实时过滤十条问答
demoCaptionEn: Yunque help center: search and category pills filter ten Q&As live

taglineZh: 选定大胆美学方向，做出不像模板的生产级界面
taglineEn: Bold, intentional aesthetics for production-grade UI
descZh: 先确定目的、调性和记忆点，再写代码：有个性的字体层级、统一色彩体系、编排过的入场动效和非常规版式。适合官网、落地页、组件等对视觉要求高的任务，产出规避 AI 通用审美的可运行前端。
descEn: Commits to a purpose, tone and memorable hook before coding: distinctive type hierarchy, one coherent color system, choreographed entrances and unconventional layout. For sites and components where visuals matter; outputs runnable frontend that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
outputZh: 有明确美学立场的可运行页面
outputEn: Runnable page with a committed aesthetic
demoCaptionZh: 山茶烘焙所咖啡页，编辑风排版与可切换的烘焙曲线
demoCaptionEn: Camellia Roastery page: editorial layout with a switchable roast curve

taglineZh: 零依赖单文件报告与看板，七条硬规则保证质量
taglineEn: Zero-dependency single-file reports under 7 craft rules
descZh: 把报告、对比、仪表盘或讲解做成一个双击就能打开的 HTML 文件，内联全部样式脚本。内置 13 种版式模式和五维自评，用六个颜色变量约束配色。适合要发给别人直接看的分析结果，不适合登录支付等后端场景。
descEn: Turns reports, comparisons, dashboards or explainers into one double-clickable HTML file with all CSS/JS inline. Ships 13 layout patterns, a five-dimension self-critique and a six-token color system. For shareable analysis artifacts, not auth or payment flows.
outputZh: 自包含单文件 HTML 报告
demoCaptionZh: 季度阅读报告看板，可切换季度并联动图表数字
demoCaptionEn: Quarterly reading report with a live quarter toggle driving chart and stats

taglineZh: 先生成设计参考图，深度分析后再还原成前端
taglineEn: Generate design references first, then code to match
descZh: 视觉优先的网页任务先产出分区设计图，逐张提取字体、间距和配色，再写代码贴近参考。避免套模板和卡片套卡片，首屏保持干净可读。适合对还原度有要求的官网和落地页，产出与参考图对照的前端实现。
descEn: For visual web work it first generates section-level design images, extracts type, spacing and color from each, then implements frontend faithful to the reference. Avoids template collapse and nested-card clutter; outputs a coded page checkable against its reference.
outputZh: 参考图 + 高保真前端实现
demoCaptionZh: 拖动滑杆对照 SVG 设计参考与代码还原的首屏
demoCaptionEn: Drag the slider to compare the SVG reference with the coded hero

taglineZh: 大衬线标题加双栏正文，报纸全版式长图
taglineEn: Oversized serif headline and two-column newsprint longform
descZh: 做读起来像报纸全版的编辑风长图：刊头日期栏、带删除线和斜体强调的大标题、双栏正文、编号小节和引文。适合宣言、复盘和观点长文，产出暖灰纸感背景的单页 HTML 长图。
descEn: Builds a newsprint-style longform poster: dateline masthead, oversized serif headline with strike-through and italic accents, two-column body, numbered sections and pull-quotes. For manifestos and essays; outputs one cream-paper HTML long image.
outputZh: 杂志排版竖版长图 HTML
demoCaptionZh: 一篇关于砍掉每日站会的杂志风长文，含引文与编号小节
demoCaptionEn: A newsprint essay on killing daily standups, with pull-quotes and numbered sections

taglineZh: 9:16 单张主视觉，渐变 mesh 加要点卡片
taglineEn: One 9:16 hero visual with mesh gradient and key points
descZh: 做一张能直接发朋友圈的竖版海报：1080×1920 渐变背景、居中大标题、三到五条图标要点、底部品牌和二维码。适合产品发布和活动预告，产出带 SVG 装饰与噪点纹理的单页 HTML。
descEn: Makes one share-ready vertical poster: 1080x1920 gradient canvas, centered display title, three to five icon-led key points, brand mark and QR at the foot. For launches and events; outputs a single HTML page with SVG ornaments and grain.
demoCaptionZh: 天台音乐会竖版海报，可一键切换三套渐变配色
demoCaptionEn: Rooftop concert poster with a one-click switch across three gradient themes

taglineZh: 三档定价卡、月年切换、对比表与 FAQ 一屏讲清
taglineEn: Three tiers, billing toggle, comparison table and FAQ
descZh: 做标准 SaaS 定价页：免费、专业、企业三档卡片，中间档高亮，月付年付切换实时改价，下面接完整特性对比表和常见问题。适合产品公开价格时使用，产出单页 HTML 模板。
descEn: Builds the standard SaaS pricing page: Free/Pro/Enterprise cards with the middle tier highlighted, a monthly/annual toggle that reprices live, then a full feature comparison table and FAQ. For publishing prices; outputs a single-page HTML template.
demoCaptionZh: 墨阵表单三档定价，月年切换实时改价并附对比表
demoCaptionEn: Inkform pricing: live monthly/annual repricing plus a comparison table

taglineZh: 可点击的高保真原型，导航到 CTA 全流程走通
taglineEn: Clickable high-fi prototype from nav to CTA
descZh: 做能给人走一遍流程的产品落地页原型：吸顶导航、英雄区双按钮、特性卡悬停浮起、步骤区和手风琴 FAQ，滚动入场动画。适合评审交互而不是只看版式，产出让人觉得明天就能上线的单页 HTML。
descEn: Builds a landing-page prototype you can actually walk through: sticky nav, dual-CTA hero, hover-lift feature cards, steps and accordion FAQ with scroll-in motion. For reviewing flows rather than static layout; outputs a ship-ready-feeling single HTML page.
demoCaptionZh: 潮汐清单原型，导航滚动、注册弹窗与 FAQ 都可操作
demoCaptionEn: TideList prototype: scrolling nav, working signup modal and FAQ

taglineZh: 一页 HTML 把复杂概念讲清：定义、类比、要点、误解
taglineEn: Explain a hard concept on one self-contained HTML page
descZh: 用一页自包含 HTML 讲清一个复杂概念：一句话定义、日常类比、3–5 条要点拆解、最小例子与常见误解。术语首次出现配白话解释，类比要指出失效处，数字必须有据。适合别人问某个东西到底是什么、不想打一大段字的场景。
descEn: Turns a hard question into one readable HTML page: one-line definition, everyday analogy, key points, a minimal example and common misconceptions. Jargon is explained on first use; analogies note where they break down; every figure stays sourced.
demoCaptionZh: 一页讲清一个概念的讲解页示例

taglineZh: 把摘录与思考整理成可长期翻阅的笔记归档页
taglineEn: Archive highlights and thoughts into a readable notes page
descZh: 把一本书或一篇长文的摘录、划线与个人思考整理成固定结构的单文件 HTML：书目信息、笔记统计、章节分组摘录、个人思考与整书综述。生成前先体检材料是否齐全，区分原文摘录与综述，不补材料里没有的情节和论点。
descEn: Organizes highlights, annotations and personal thoughts into a structured single-file HTML: book metadata, note counts, chapter-grouped excerpts, reflections and a synthesized recap. Completeness is checked first; excerpts stay verbatim and synthesis never invents missing material.
